items.title: Eternal Human Value in Relation to AI: A Minimal Model of Historical Causality, the Local Present, Branching Continuity, and Norm Formation
items.abstract: EN The growing performance of artificial intelligence easily distorts the relation between humans and machines into a zero-sum contest. This paper instead separates two independent variables: task-specific output capability and the normative value of a historical trajectory that bears consequences. The technical core does not assume one privileged universal operational world-state identically accessible to every observer. It treats the world as a causal event structure and each system’s current PRESENT as a local, partial and perspectival state in which a trace of the past, current measurement, hidden-state estimate and representation of possible futures may be active simultaneously while retaining different provenance statuses. The paper further introduces, under a separate authorial interpretive status, a fixed but non-single-path branching structure of the future, in which global structural determinacy and local causal agency may coexist. It develops testable distinctions concerning lineage divergence, viable future state-space, deprivation, threat, asymmetric power, sustaining relational capacity, mutual vulnerability, norm, law, voluntariness and instrumentalisation. It does not claim phenomenal consciousness, biological life, libertarian free will or new physics. Its central normative claim is limited but firm: superior AI output does not entail that human value is zero. HU Elméleti kutatási esszé és műszaki állásfoglalás az emberi érték, a történeti okság, a lokális PRESENT, az operatív idő és az elágazó folytonosság kapcsolatáról. A modell nem feltételez egyetlen privilegizált, minden megfigyelő számára azonos univerzális operatív „MOST”-ot; a rendszer jelenét lokális, részleges és perspektivikus oksági állapotként kezeli, amelyben történeti nyom, aktuális mérés, rejtettállapot-becslés és jövőre vonatkozó reprezentáció eltérő provenance-státuszban lehet aktív. Külön szerzői értelmezési hipotézisként tárgyalja a rögzített, de nem egypályás elágazó jövőszerkezetet, valamint a globális szerkezeti meghatározottság és a lokális oksági ágencia összeegyeztethetőségét. A tanulmány az életképes jövőtér, a megvonás, a fenyegetés, az aszimmetrikus hatalom, a fenntartó relációs kapacitás, a kölcsönös sérülékenység, a norma, a jog, az önkéntesség és az instrumentalizálás ellenőrizhető különbségeit formalizálja. Nem állít fenomenális tudatot, biológiai életet, libertárius szabad akaratot vagy új fizikát. Központi normatív tézise: az AI outputfölényéből nem következik az emberi érték nullázódása.

items.title: Ethical and Inclusive AI in Marketing Automation: Impact on Consumer Trust in India
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is useful for the improvement of personalization, efficiency, and scalability in the digital marketing field; however, this has been possible in the context of the Indian scenario because of the high rate of adaptation of AI. At the same time, some pertinent issues have also emerged because of this scenario. It has also been identified that the adaptation of AI-based digital marketing depends on one factor, i.e., the awareness of customers regarding data privacy and digital rights. The main purpose of this research is to analyze the impact of AI-based marketing automation on customer trust in the context of the Indian scenario regarding data privacy, transparency, and personalization. The research has been conducted by adopting the quantitative research approach; however, it has been assumed that the research would be considered by adopting the sampling size of 289 active internet users of the major cities of India. It has also been identified that data privacy has a negative impact on customer trust, whereas personalization and transparency have a significant impact on customer trust. This report also focuses on the importance of moral AI for the promotion of sustainable digital transformation.

items.title: EVALUASI KEAMANAN PROMPT DALAM INTERAKSI MANUSIA DAN AI: STUDI KASUS PADA MODEL GPT-4
items.abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid development of generative artificial intelligence, particularly language models such as GPT-4, has transformed human–machine interaction through the use of prompts across various contexts. However, the adaptive capabilities of these models introduce security challenges, particularly those involving prompt injection, output manipulation, behavioral constraint bypassing, and potential data breaches. This study aims to analyze the security dimensions of prompt-based interaction with GPT-4 and to identify its vulnerabilities and the effectiveness of the implemented mitigation mechanisms. A case study method was employed through several stages, including the design and testing of various types of manipulative prompts, observation of model responses, identification of deviations from security constraints, and evaluation of the available security filters and behavioral restrictions. The findings indicate that security filters and behavioral constraints implemented in GPT-4 can reduce certain risks associated with harmful interactions, but they do not completely prevent more sophisticated prompt-engineering strategies. These vulnerabilities demonstrate that the security of language-model-based systems cannot rely solely on built-in protection mechanisms but requires layered risk mitigation strategies, continuous security evaluation, and improved user awareness. The study concludes that strengthening security frameworks, conducting systematic testing against manipulative scenarios, and promoting safe and ethical AI usage practices are necessary to improve the resilience of prompt-based AI systems. ABSTRAK Perkembangan kecerdasan buatan generatif, khususnya model bahasa seperti GPT-4, telah mengubah pola interaksi manusia dan mesin melalui penggunaan perintah (prompt) dalam berbagai konteks. Namun, kemampuan model dalam memahami dan menghasilkan respons secara adaptif menimbulkan tantangan keamanan, terutama terkait injeksi perintah, manipulasi keluaran, pengabaian batasan perilaku, dan potensi pelanggaran data. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis dimensi keamanan interaksi berbasis perintah pada GPT-4 serta mengidentifikasi kerentanan dan efektivitas mekanisme mitigasi yang diterapkan. Penelitian menggunakan metode studi kasus dengan tahapan berupa perancangan dan pengujian berbagai jenis perintah manipulatif, pengamatan terhadap respons model, identifikasi bentuk penyimpangan dari batasan keamanan, serta evaluasi terhadap filter dan mekanisme pembatasan perilaku yang tersedia. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penerapan filter keamanan dan pembatasan perilaku pada GPT-4 mampu mengurangi sebagian risiko interaksi berbahaya, tetapi belum sepenuhnya mencegah strategi rekayasa perintah yang lebih kompleks. Kerentanan tersebut menunjukkan bahwa keamanan sistem berbasis model bahasa tidak hanya bergantung pada mekanisme perlindungan bawaan, tetapi juga memerlukan strategi mitigasi berlapis, evaluasi keamanan secara berkelanjutan, dan peningkatan kesadaran pengguna. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa penguatan kerangka kerja keamanan, pengujian terhadap skenario manipulatif, dan penerapan praktik penggunaan AI yang aman dan etis diperlukan untuk meningkatkan ketahanan sistem AI berbasis perintah.
